notes: PMYSDP Batch-I used a different monitoring checklist (10 questions) from the other programs, so it has its own 11-criteria rubric (Attendance + 10 checklist items) totalling 100. The template layout, Trade Wise / Total / Grading formulas and grade bands are unchanged.

Every criterion score is a FORMULA reading the monitor's answer in the grey 'raw answer' columns at the right of the Combined Sheet. To correct a score, change the answer (e.g. 'No' -> 'Yes'); the score, total and grade update automatically.

The source MARKS/100 was pulled by XLOOKUP from an external workbook ('Comparative Analysis - PMYSDP.xlsx', Scoring Data) that is not part of this file, and cannot be reproduced from the checklist. It is kept, unchanged, in 'Source MARKS/100 (institute)' for comparison only.

Source sheet 'Combined 198' is the master (the ICT / AJK / GB / Punjab tabs are the same rows split by region; Sheet1 is a pivot). Institutes were regrouped so each one's trades sit together; 2 exact duplicate rows (CORVIT Networks Muzaffarabad) were removed.
Enrolled = Approved Capacity - Dropped Out. Batches, Institute Trade Code and Trade Code are not in the source and are left blank.
7 institutes that withdrew / closed / had no trainees (overall impression 'Poor', MARKS 0-15) get Grade Override = Poor, with the monitor's explanation in Remarks.
60 institutes fall in a different grade band than their source MARKS would give - listed in the Change Log.

notes: Source 'Complete Dataset' holds raw survey answers (Yes/No, Good/Poor...) and a typed-in 'Final Scoring' with no formula. Each answer is now converted to its criterion score (mapping in the table above) so every score has its own column.

The source Final Scoring did not count Job Fair / Engagement Plan, so its maximum was 97.5. As agreed, Job Fair is now included (2.5) and the maximum is 100. Institutes with a Job Fair plan gain 2.5 points.
Students Feedback = average of the 9 trainee questions. This reproduces the source feedback component exactly for ~70% of rows; the rest differ by 0.28 or less (the source formula was not recorded).
487 trade rows have a Trade Wise Score different from the source Final Scoring (mainly +2.5 for Job Fair). The source value is kept in the column 'Original Final Score (source)' for reconciliation.
Enrolled = Approved Capacity - Dropped Out (the source formula AI = AH - AJ). Attendance % uses Approved Capacity as the base, as the source did.

Region Name follows the template convention: Islamabad -> ICT, AJK -> AJK, Gilgit Baltistan -> GB, Punjab divisions -> PUNJAB. The source 'Region' (ICT / Punjab = NAVTTC regional office) is kept in the extra column.
Institutes with remark 'Fake Institute' or 'Not Functional' (from the 'Institute Wise Scores' sheet) get Grade Override = Poor, matching the source Impression.
Institute rows were regrouped so each institute's trades sit together (the source had some institutes split across the sheet). Exact duplicate rows were removed (see Change Log).
Institute Trade Code and Trade Code are not provided in the source and are left blank.
Attendance 0% now scores 0 (band 01-49% starts at 1%, as in the template). The source gave 10 to some batches with 0 trainees present; each case is in the Change Log.
